_comment: KabuK Exchange site configuration. Non-engineers can safely edit the values below. Placeholder values are marked with PLACEHOLDER — replace before going live.
_siteUrlHelp: The site's public HTTPS address (no trailing slash). The production build uses it for canonical and Open Graph tags, sitemap.xml, robots.txt and the GitHub Pages CNAME file, and refuses anything that is not https://.
_securityHelp: The production build adds a Content-Security-Policy and a referrer policy to every page as meta tags (GitHub Pages cannot send custom headers). If you add analytics, a CRM form endpoint or another third-party service, list its origin in the matching extra* list (for example https://www.googletagmanager.com) or browsers will block it. formMode 'api' adds the apiEndpoint origin to connect-src automatically.
_footerCompanyStyleHelp: How the KabuK Style Inc. footer column renders: 'text' (default) or 'icons' (A/B candidate — shows the service icons below).
_featureFlagsHelp: LAUNCH GATES for the new network, directory, ecosystem and homepage showcase features. All six ship false. Set one to true ONLY after its LAUNCH_CHECKLIST.md section is signed off, then run 'python3 build.py --production' and deploy the dist/ folder. Disabled features are left out of dist/ entirely (pages, nav links, sitemap entries and data files). Changing this file on a live server without rebuilding does NOT publish a page.
_languageUrlsHelp: SEO LANGUAGE URLS. Ships false. When enabled is true, 'python3 build.py --production' also writes static, indexable copies of the listed pages for each listed language (/ja/hotels/, /ar/about/ …) with the copy from i18n/<code>.json rendered into the HTML, the right lang/dir, self-referencing canonicals, a full hreflang set (+ x-default = English) and sitemap entries; the language selector then links to those URLs. English URLs do not change. The non-English copy is machine-assisted draft (TRANSLATION_REVIEW.md): set enabled to true ONLY after it has been reviewed and the owner approves publication. Pages listed here that are launch-gated are skipped while their feature flag is off.
_disclosureHelp: Site-wide disclosure approvals. bakuunNameApproved: set true only with written authorization to name Bakuun publicly. While false, production output never names Bakuun: every 'bakuun' connection renders as 'Via Technology Partner' and Bakuun examples are left out of the badge gallery. Per-record approvals (connectionProviderDisclosureApproved) are still required.
_featuresHelp: Legacy module switches. partnerLogos, featuredProperties and networkMetrics are superseded by featureFlags (partnerEcosystem, homepageFeaturedHotels, networkStats) and no longer render anything; they are kept so older tooling does not break.
_kabukPlatformUrlNote: PLACEHOLDER — replace with the public KabuK Platform website URL when finalized. While this value is empty, '#', or an example.com address, every KabuK Platform link renders as a non-clickable 'Learn more soon' treatment.
